messages.subject: Quartz — W&I quote from Aldgate
messages.plaintextBody:
James — Aldgate Specialty have quoted a premium of c.£165k for a £12m W&I tower at 1% retention. We'll take it; it lets us keep the retention modest at £2m and gives Geoffrey comfort. Please make sure the funds flow reflects the premium and that the SPA warranties dovetail with the W&I policy.

Daniel
